## SimpleHarness CLI

| OS | CPU | File |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Windows | x64 (Intel · AMD) | `simpleharness-windows-amd64.exe` |
| Windows | ARM64 | `simpleharness-windows-arm64.exe` |
| macOS | Apple Silicon (M1+) | `simpleharness-darwin-arm64` |
| macOS | Intel | `simpleharness-darwin-amd64` |
| Linux | x64 | `simpleharness-linux-amd64` |
| Linux | ARM64 | `simpleharness-linux-arm64` |

`SHA256SUMS.txt` — SHA-256 checksums of every file above.

- **한국어** — 결과물을 모을 폴더에서 터미널을 열고 실행하면 그 폴더에 `output/<프로젝트 이름>/` 이 생겨요. 운영체제별 실행 방법은 [README](https://github.com/GarnetRapture/SimpleEngineering#다운로드)를 보세요.
- **English** — Run it from a terminal in the folder where the result should go; it creates `output/<project name>/` there. Per-OS steps: [README.en.md](https://github.com/GarnetRapture/SimpleEngineering/blob/main/README.en.md#download).
- **简体中文** — 在希望生成结果的文件夹中打开终端运行，会在该文件夹生成 `output/<项目名称>/`。各操作系统的运行方法见 [README.zh-CN.md](https://github.com/GarnetRapture/SimpleEngineering/blob/main/README.zh-CN.md#下载)。
